info.name: Corrections route returns all eCFR corrections.

params.name: date
params.description: Restricts results to eCFR corrections that occurred on or before the specified date and that were corrected on or after the specified date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: title
params.description: Restricts results to the given title number: Format: '1', '2', '50', etc

params.name: error_corrected_date
params.description: Returns only corrections that were corrected on the given date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

items.docs: The Corrections service can be used to determine all corrections or can be filtered by title, effective date, or correction date.

info.name: Corrections title route returns all corrections for the supplied title.

params.name: title
params.description: Restricts results to the given title number: Format: '1', '2', '50', etc

items.docs: The Corrections service can be used to determine all corrections for the given title.
